title: WITHDRAWN: overlapping fragment descriptors (obsolete)
description: SAR archive where two fragment descriptors have overlapping byte ranges. Must fail with an invalid map error regardless of LOSS_TOLERANT.
notes: WITHDRAWN (WP-4): canonical LFH has no absolute-offset descriptor, so fragment overlap is unrepresentable in SAR v1.0. Retained only as a historical reference; the canonical duplicate-Fragment-Index case is invalid/fragmentation/duplicate-index.
